comment: Approved exceptions to the Sub feature freeze (docs/FEATURE_FREEZE.md). Every entry requires approved_by=michaelayoade and is reviewed via CODEOWNERS on this file. kinds: feature-exception (must name starter_contract), schema (corrective migration), transitional-tool (must name deletion_trigger), approved-growth (owner-approved pinned-surface growth, no new capability).

exceptions.reason: Michael explicitly approved Sub #3624 and its scoped thin-client exception on 2026-10-14 (merged 2fd54e6d; recorded in Knowledge dotmac-billing-cutover-orchestration-2026-10-14 v9): net +232 billing lines on the same 137-file inventory (92265 -> 92497), of which +175 in three existing transitional opening-evidence tools and +57 of repair-CLI freeze guards in existing scripts. No new capability, no new files. This entry reconciles the ratchet baseline deliberately to the accepted source; it does not authorize further growth.
exceptions.deletion_trigger: Transitional opening-evidence tools delete at the opening seal (see billing_transitional_tools.json); this exception entry is removed when the baseline next shrinks past 92265.

exceptions.reason: Michael explicitly approved PR #3628 (abb1a8e2) on 2026-10-14: +4 lines for the stale ORM snapshot correction on the same 137-file inventory (92497 -> 92501). No new capability; no further growth is authorized. Provenance: canonical global Knowledge record dotmac-billing-cutover-orchestration-2026-10-14 v22.
exceptions.deletion_trigger: Remove this exception with the proof when Starter numbering is activated for Sub and the disjointness proof is archived.

exceptions.reason: Michael explicitly approved this scoped exception for PR #3630 on 2026-10-14. It covers only the listed network control-plane composition and router-control modules; CODEOWNERS review of this file remains required before merge.
exceptions.starter_contract: Starter network control-plane composition API v1: typed layers, deterministic composition with provenance, and read-only drift reporting.

exceptions.reason: Michael explicitly approved the scoped exception for Sub PR #3640 at 189d0722a38a92602dc6843653a9f00af92f51e9 on 2026-10-15. Owner: financial.payment_intent_module_shadow; steward: finance operations. Actual production growth is 246 lines: 151 adapter, 5 caller, 6 metrics and 84 SOT declaration. This covers only a read-only consumer of the published Payments intent contract, with no settlement authority, cap relaxation or additional capability. Source merge requires current green CI and separate billing-owner approval.
exceptions.starter_contract: Published dotmac-payments 0.1.0a2 GetPaymentIntentV1 / get_payment_intent_v1: caller-owned tenant-scoped Session, persisted immutable intent binding observation, no autoflush or settlement authority.
exceptions.deletion_trigger: Delete the adapter, caller hook, metric, SOT entry and this exception when approved Payments ownership and complete backfill/parity permit retirement of legacy checkout bindings.

exceptions.reason: Michael directed the thin-client health goal on 2026-10-16: keep the existing poller/syslog probes and product semantics Sub-local, serialize Starter Platform Health observations at the source edge, and create no Sub health subsystem or deployment authority. He approved commit, push and draft PR #3655 for hosted CI. This entry covers only the listed bounded serialization module; modifications to the existing probe owners need no exception. CODEOWNERS review of this file remains required before merge.
exceptions.starter_contract: Starter dotmac-platform-health HealthObservationInput: source_ref, observation_key, component_code, healthy/degraded/unhealthy/unknown state, observed_at, received_at, summary and bounded labels; Platform Health remains the future sole durable observation/evidence owner and Integrator remains the authenticated transport boundary.

exceptions.reason: Michael explicitly approved consolidating PRs #3642 through #3655, resolving their conflicts, merging the result and continuing the digest-gated release on 2026-10-16. This entry covers only the source preparation in PR #3668: bounded deployment drain evidence, trusted migration controls, typed Payments intent adoption, provenance-bound PSP observations, immutable provider/source facts, private legacy-fence participants and the existing probe owners that feed the separately approved THIN-3655 serializer. It does not activate the final Billing handoff, grant financial authority, relax a baseline or authorize additional growth.
exceptions.starter_contract: Published dotmac-kernel 0.1.0a105 conflict protocol, dotmac-payments 0.1.0a2 payment-intent contracts and dotmac-billing 0.1.0a1 opening/handoff contracts; Sub retains only the typed caller, observation, deployment-evidence and legacy-fence responsibilities required for the future single-owner cutover.
exceptions.deletion_trigger: Remove this exception as the private preparation surfaces retire after the accepted single Billing handoff and the remaining probe serialization moves behind the authenticated Platform Health transport.

exceptions.reason: Michael explicitly approved the consolidated corrective schema scope for PR #3668 on 2026-10-16. The incumbent schema can represent an unpaired Payments intent, mutable invoice-cash correlation and verified provider facts that drift after observation. Revisions 691-693 add the paired tenant identity, immutable correlation and exact source-fact guards needed to fail closed while preserving historical rows; they do not switch ledger authority.
